description: DEMO portfolio (synthetic, shared, read-only). The Portfolio value chart's lines on up to 6 dates, from the series the chart draws: value, valueDate, change and returnPct since the chart start (from), ranking, highestBenchmark. date: YYYY-MM-DD or "today" (one or a list; omitted = today). lines: "Portfolio Total", an account, type:/sector:/category:<name>, or "inflation" (the inflation hurdle; adds real returns). from: YYYY-MM-DD, or "" for the first transaction. benchmarks: keys or custom benchmark names. In the in-app chat lines, benchmarks and from default to the chart on screen. A benchmark line is the same money flows invested in that benchmark instead: every day the portfolio bought or sold securities, the same amount buys or sells the benchmark at that day's price, and a later chart start opens it with the whole portfolio value bought on that day.
